rules: N5/N4 kanji only, else the whole word in hiragana
words normally written in hiragana stay in hiragana
one bracket per kanji word, okurigana outside
the kanji matches the meaning in context
a common word with N4 kanji is not left in hiragana
a choose item writes its options alike
method: A scripted pass checked every twin's kanji against the N5/N4 list (no findings), and publish.check_draft checked every reading. The drafter's own review pass and a separate LM judge session that did not write the twins then read every twin in context. Each finding names the twin by point, item (ex<N> example or p<N> practice), field and list index.

dismissed.why: mari.L33.3's first example is Mari's verbatim text with the kanji sign 「立入禁止」. publish.twin_errors checks this twin against the printed text, so only the sign may carry a bracket; the fix would print 入っては and 意味, which are not in Mari's text.
